comparison.objective: Remove and discard an old filter cartridge, then insert and seat a new one while stabilizing the jug; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pull-out, disposal, replacement insertion, and seating versus bimanual impact-tool control, notch fracture, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge binned, new cartridge seated, jug stable, and arms reset versus four fractures and tray-contained tangs without shell or insert damage.
comparison.reason: Cartridge exchange tests extraction and replacement, not controlled impact fracture.
